title: Völva: crystallite size and microstrain from powder X-ray diffraction line broadening
description:
Völva measures crystallite size and microstrain from powder X-ray diffraction line broadening. It fits each reflection as a pseudo-Voigt Kα1 + Kα2 doublet, removes a measured instrument profile component by component (Gaussian widths in quadrature, Lorentzian widths linearly), and runs six methods (Scherrer, single-line Voigt, Monshi–Scherrer, Williamson–Hall, Voigt Williamson–Hall and Halder–Wagner) with Monte Carlo uncertainties. It reports where the methods agree, which of their assumptions the data contradict, and when a size is only a bound. It is a PySide6 desktop application, a command line and a Python package.

CHANGELOG.md describes every version.
